 	"strconv"

+	"sync"
 	"syscall"
 	"time"
 )
@@ -17,6 +18,31 @@ import (
 // killed with SIGKILL.
 const psBound = 5 * time.Second
 
+var (
+	psBoundMu  sync.Mutex
+	psBoundNow = psBound
+)
+
+// overridePSBound is the test seam: until the returned restore is called, every ps run is
+// bounded by d instead of psBound. restore puts back the value in effect before the call.
+func overridePSBound(d time.Duration) (restore func()) {
+	psBoundMu.Lock()
+	prev := psBoundNow
+	psBoundNow = d
+	psBoundMu.Unlock()
+	return func() {
+		psBoundMu.Lock()
+		psBoundNow = prev
+		psBoundMu.Unlock()
+	}
+}
+
+func psTimeout() time.Duration {
+	psBoundMu.Lock()
+	defer psBoundMu.Unlock()
+	return psBoundNow
+}
+
 // psWaitDelay is how long past the kill the wait for the output pipe may last, in case a
 // process outside the group still holds it.
 const psWaitDelay = time.Second
@@ -67,7 +93,8 @@ func runPS(pid int, columns ...string) ([]byte, error) {

 	}
